findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

(REPEAT) Observed the ice machine baffle to have a significant amount of mold. Inspector showed employee. Ensure the ice machine is washed, rinsed, and sanitized as needed to prevent mold build-up. Ice has to be discarded due to facility being on boil order, as well as the mold within the machine. Discard the ice; wash, rinse, sanitize the interior of the ice machine including the baffle lip; change the filter on the ice machine due to the boil order. Inspector will follow-up on 12/18/23. Repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 12/2/21.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Observed no quaternary ammonium test strips for the facility. Facility is using quat tablets for sanitizer. Facility has bleach test strips. Discussed with employee. Ensure test strips are bought by 12/18/23. Inspector will follow-up.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

Ice is observed with black specs both in the ice and on the surface of the ice in both the ice bin (bar) and the ice machine (back room). Contaminated ice was discarded during the inspection to correct. PIC instructed to have the ice machine cleaned and inspector will spot check in the future.
